## Overview

This model is part of the Lyria series and is designed to provide a preview of the capabilities of the full Lyria 3 model. The architecture of Google: Lyria 3 Clip Preview is not explicitly stated, but its capabilities suggest a transformer-based design, given its support for text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, structured outputs, and vision tasks.
